name: WolfMounfed
identity: Compact low quadruped wolf, dark gray-taupe and olive-brown fur with lighter gray-khaki jagged cheek and throat tufts, sparse round ochre spots. Large angular canine skull, two tall triangular pointed ears, thick brows, ivory eyes with small black pupils, dark brown nose, cream canine teeth. One golden ochre leather riding saddle is integrated with the BODY: raised golden rim, darker segmented rectangular seat, three short ivory conical spikes on its REAR rim, and ONE silver-gray circular X-shaped screw/buckle on the left girth side. No rider. No collar. Four short sturdy spotted legs with rounded paws. Long broad thick gray-taupe tail curves out from the rump and DOWN to a pointed rightward tuft, lighter gray-khaki inner fur. No winter-white mane or bib, no head armor, no handheld weapon, no horns or invented equipment.
